rules: supported: 12+ signal months, 2+ distinct episodes caught, lift >= 1.5, permutation p <= 0.10 · rejected: 12+ signal months and lift <= 1.0 or p >= 0.5 · else inconclusive

hypotheses.statement: Market blindness (fundamentals worsening, markets calm) is followed by a 20 % drawdown within 18 months
hypotheses.lesson: 2006-07: delinquencies climbed for a year under the tightest spreads on record

hypotheses.statement: Loss data in their top 15 % of stress precede a 20 % drawdown within 18 months
An inverted yield curve (10y below 3m) precedes a recession within 24 months
Fed funds up 1.5 pts or more in 12 months precede a 15 % drawdown within 12 months
Oil up 50 % or more in a year precedes a recession within 12 months
Stock market value / GDP in its top decile is followed by below-median 12-month returns
Top-decile valuation while the Fed tightens precedes a 20 % drawdown within 18 months
hypotheses.lesson: 2000 (and 1987, 2022): a rate shock into prices far ahead of profits

hypotheses.statement: Initial claims up 20 % or more year on year precede a recession within 12 months
hypotheses.lesson: labour turns before the recession is declared

hypotheses.statement: The marginal buyer stepping back (commercial paper or asset-backed paper at a stress extreme) precedes a 15 % drawdown within 12 months
hypotheses.lesson: summer 2007: the buyers of ABCP and CDOs stopped

hypotheses.statement: Banks tightening business credit (net 30 %+) precede a recession within 12 months
Organic expansion is followed by an above-median 12-month return
Debt-fuelled late cycle precedes a 20 % drawdown within 18 months
hypotheses.lesson: credit outrunning income ends in a de-leveraging

hypotheses.statement: Acute stress (funding markets in their top decile) is followed by an above-median 12-month return (capitulation)
hypotheses.lesson: 2009-03, 2020-03: the panic was the bottom - or 2008-10: it wasn't

hypotheses.statement: Baa spreads widening 0.75 pt or more in 6 months precede a recession within 12 months
Composite risk at the 90th percentile or higher precedes a 20 % drawdown within 12 months
Euphoria (Nasdaq up 50 % or more in a year) precedes a 20 % drawdown within 18 months
A rate shock (10-year yield up 1.5 pts in 6 months) precedes a 10 % drawdown within 6 months
Commercial real-estate delinquencies in their top decile precede a recession within 12 months

method: Signals on the publication-lagged monthly panel; outcomes from daily closes and NBER recession starts; p-values by circular-shift permutation (the signal slid along history keeps its persistence); exploration controls the false-discovery rate (Benjamini-Hochberg, 10 %); every 'on' signal is logged as a dated prediction and graded when its horizon passes.
